newsitem.title: USA: Key US lawmaker endorses Powell for FCC post.
newsitem.headline: Key US lawmaker endorses Powell for FCC post.

text.p: A key U.S. House lawmaker on Thursday said he was endorsing Justice Department lawyer Michael Powell to fill a seat on the Federal Communications Commission.

"I firmly believe that Michael's substantive telecommunications expertise combined with his personal commitment to public service make him an outstanding candidate for the vacant Republican seat on the Federal Communications Commission," said Rep Billy Tauzin, a Louisiana Republican who chairs the telecommunications subcommittee.
Tauzin, in a letter to Sen John McCain, said he "strongly" supports Powell's candidacy. Powell is the son of former Joint Chiefs of Staff chairman Colin Powell.
McCain, an Arizona Republican who chairs the Senate Commerce Committee, also has called on President Clinton to nominate Powell.
